obligations.text: IPM resolves the whole dependency tree before it loads any dependency.
obligations.cases: resolution fails (dependency not found / conflict) vs succeeds
obligations.observation: which dependencies were loaded when resolution fails
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: The crate fails at lnm_deps before any LoadModuleReference when !all_found, and contract dep_upto requires no dependency touched; but resolution is reduced to a per-dependency found flag (no conflict case), and the only passing explorer runs over L1 use the conforming domain (filtered by the check itself). dep_resolve proves resolution soundness but has no load step. Contrast: a two-dependency module whose second dependency conflicts leaves the first not installed.

obligations.text: Resolution runs across the enabled repositories, one level of the tree at a time.
obligations.cases: breadth-first vs depth-first visiting; enabled vs disabled repository offers
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: dep_resolve dequeues by (depth, name) and proves soundness, but no theorem contrasts level order with another order, and the registry search (Repo/Manager.cls SearchRepositoriesForModule over enabled repositories) is a trusted input. Contrast: a disabled repository's offer is never chosen.

obligations.text: Every load parameter other than DeveloperMode is passed on to dependency loads (DeveloperMode exception owned by dev-mode.not-propagated).

Contrast: load -DFoo=1 of a parent makes ${Foo} expand to 1 in the dependency's manifest.

obligations.text: When no version can satisfy every requirement, IPM stops the load with an error.
obligations.cases: unsatisfiable vs satisfiable requirements
obligations.basis: new:iteration-70
obligations.gap: dep_refines shows a resolution that ends Done is sound, so an unsatisfiable instance never ends Done, and Failed carries a reason; termination is not claimed, so "stops with an error" is not proved, and the load-level failure appears only in the crate as a found flag. The greedy witness shows failure also on some solvable instances.

obligations.text: The conflict error names the modules whose requirements conflict.

obligations.gap: No model of the message built in Storage/Module.cls (around :954-959). Contrast: A requires C =1.0.0 and B requires C =2.0.0 gives an error naming A and B (and C).

obligations.text: In developer mode, resolution happens after the first commit, so the saved manifest stays when resolution fails.

obligations.gap: The crate orders the dev commit C1 before lnm_deps and l1_alts expects the manifest kept for verdict 6 under -dev. But case_c33 exercises a dependency Activate failure, not a resolution failure; no theorem or non-conforming passing explorer run exercises Pkg.found=false or a version conflict under -dev.
